text:
Marta (CS): Hi team — CedarPath just finished their data onboarding and asked for a short-term QPS bump for APAC egress while they run a 48h pilot. They also need our edge IPs added to their allowlist. Can we coordinate?
Sam (CS): Thanks Marta. Do we have the CIDR/IPs and desired QPS numbers?
Marta (CS): CedarPath provided these: 54.198.12.34, 13.250.66.11, 203.120.4.0/24. Requesting +2x QPS for 48 hours (from 200 -> 400 qps) starting 2024-04-18 02:00 UTC. They want auto-revoke after window.
Jia (AM): flagging renewal risk — onboarding delays pushed their pilot timelines. If we can make this smooth it'll help their renewal convo next week.
NetOps: @Marta can you confirm whether the traffic will come from those three IPs only? We need an internal ticket for prod firewall change and ACLs.
Marta (CS): Confirmed from customer: only those three. Also asked for a health-check endpoint whitelist: /healthz and /metrics for our probe.
NetOps: OK creating ticket. Config snippet we'll push (example):
```
acl:
  - ip: "54.198.12.34"
    role: "edge-proxy"
  - ip: "13.250.66.11"
    role: "edge-proxy"
  - cidr: "203.120.4.0/24"
    role: "edge-proxy"
qps_override: 400
window: "2024-04-18T02:00:00Z/2024-04-20T02:00:00Z"
auto_revoke: true
```
NetOps: Ticket #CS-8472 created, assigned to infra-team. ETA firewall change: 45m if no issues.
deploy-bot: deploy started for acl-updates -> infra-edge (build 5482).
Sam (CS): Can we add a simple smoke test after change? Want to validate latency and 429 rate for baseline.
NetOps: Yep — will run 5 min synthetic at 350 qps and capture 95p latency. Will paste results back.
Marta (CS): FYI I told CedarPath we'll confirm within the hour and that the window will auto-revoke. Also captured renewal note and slack a follow-up playbook to AM.
Jia (AM): Please add renewal tag to ticket and set reminder for a check-in 3 days after pilot ends.
NetOps: ACL pushed, deploy succeeded :white_check_mark:. Running smoke now.
deploy-bot: smoke-test: 350 qps for 5m -> 0 errors, 95p latency 180ms.
NetOps: Smoke looks good. No 429s observed. Rolling to prod ruleets now.
Marta (CS): Sending confirmation to CedarPath and updating the interim onboarding checklist. Will capture their feedback after 24h.
Sam (CS): Thanks all. Flagging in renewal doc that pilot executed on time — lowers immediate risk.
Marta (CS): Closing thread once customer confirms. :eyes:
